annotations.title: Add an answer to a shim

description: Adds one answer (a label and, optionally, when it applies). The shim needs three examples of it before it builds again with the new answer. May return `needs_confirmation`.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: workbench_shim_add_answer
title: Add an answer to a shim
